about.title: About Pasadena Family Dentistry
text: Many dentistry patients think of the dental office as simply a dreaded obligation that they can’t wait to be finished with – but what if when you visited, you felt comfortable, well cared for, and respected by everyone you came in contact with? At Pasadena Family Dentistry, that’s what our dental team strives to provide each day to dentistry patients of all ages. We devote all of our energy to giving you the high-quality, personalized experience you deserve, and we do so with pleasure.

Dr. Revel, and Dr. Lowery don’t believe in baseline dentistry that views a patient as simply another number. Instead, we take the time to get to know you and your loved ones. This commitment to relationship-building is just one of the many reasons so many keep coming back! While helping you to feel more like family, we’ll also work toward building brighter, healthier smiles that will last a lifetime.

We know dental care can be costly, which is why we always take the time to sit down and discuss the process of your treatment as well as the financial obligations that come with it. A member of our team will go over available payment options so that you are fully aware of any out-of-pocket expenses before you agree to move forward with treatment.
